# Official brand assets

Retrieved 2026-10-22 from the brands' own websites and download packs. Icons keep their original artwork and colors; ICO assets were decoded to PNG without redrawing them. The portfolio self-hosts these files.

| Local asset | Official source |
| --- | --- |
| mphasis-icon.png | https://www.mphasis.com/content/dam/mphasis-com/common/icons/favicon.ico |
| capgemini.svg | https://www.capgemini.com/wp-content/themes/capgemini2025/resources/assets/images/capgemini-mobile-logo-blue.svg |
| acnovate-icon.png | https://www.acnovate.com/templates/corporate_response/favicon.ico |
| hp-icon.png | https://www.hp.com/favicon.ico |
| synchrony.png | https://www.synchrony.com/syc/img/apple-touch-icon-precomposed.png |
| adidas.svg | https://www.adidas-group.com/en/public/adidas-logo.svg |
| linkedin.png | LI-In-Bug.png from https://content.linkedin.com/content/dam/me/business/en-us/amp/xbu/linkedin-revised-brand-guidelines/logos/in-logo.zip |
| github.svg | GitHub_Invertocat_Black.svg from https://brand.github.com/GitHub_Logos.zip |

Brand references: [LinkedIn](https://brand.linkedin.com/downloads), [GitHub](https://brand.github.com/foundations/logo). The marks identify employers, clients, and profile-link destinations; they do not indicate endorsement.
